scheme_name: Shramyogi Home Town Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The worker must have been employed continuously with the company in Gujarat for at least one year.
The labour welfare fund of the worker must be deposited with the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.
The benefit can be availed only once in a two‑year block (currently 2022‑23 and 2023‑24).
If both husband and wife are employed, only one of them can receive the benefit.
The worker must obtain prior approval before travelling and submit necessary proofs within one month of completing the tour.
benefits_summary: The scheme provides payment of railway fare for migrant labourers to travel to or from their hometown, with the assistance amount credited to the beneficiary’s bank account via DBT.
